title: Molecular Dynamics Simulations Reveal a Broadly Open Solution Ensemble for the DNA Holliday Junction: Mg(2+) Crossover Bridging and Weak Force-Field Sensitivity.
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟研究DNA Holliday junction的溶液构象系综，虽对象为DNA而非蛋白质，但其构象采样和力场比较方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算，具有方法借鉴价值。
abstract: Holliday junctions, four-way DNA crossovers central to DNA origami and key intermediates of homologous recombination, must be accurately modeled for rational DNA-nanodevice design, yet their solution conformational ensemble remains incompletely characterized. We characterize this ensemble for the experimental junction d(TCGGTACCGA)(4) by all-atom molecular dynamics, comparing the AMBER force fields parmbsc1, OL21, and OL24 in OPC water with matched ionic conditions. In every force field, the junction explores a broad, nearly flat inter-arm-angle landscape, with <1 kcal/mol variation across inter-arm angles of 2-90 degrees : the open state is favored by 0.45-0.63 kcal/mol, the crystallographic-like inter-arm angle occurs in 2-5% of frames, and the crossover remains coaxially stacked whether open or compact. A Mg(2+) ion occupies the crossover pocket in 92-94% of frames, specifically bridging the A- and C-strand phosphates (Li-Merz CM Mg(2+) set). Stacking-isomer exchange between the A/C-continuous and crystallographic B/D isomers proceeds at ~0.5 ns(-1) in this minimal short-arm construct, independent of force field, with A/C-continuous favored ~2:1. parmbsc1 yields a more open junction than OL21 and OL24, which reproduce the crystallographic inter-arm angle of 39-43 degrees ; the sugar-pucker shift targeted in OL24 is also visible at the junction. These results establish a force-field-robust baseline for simulation-guided design of crossover-containing nanostructures.
abstract_zh: Holliday连接体（Holliday junctions）是DNA折纸术中的四向DNA交叉结构，也是同源重组的关键中间体，必须精确建模以实现合理的DNA纳米器件设计，但其溶液构象系综仍未完全表征。我们通过全原子分子动力学（molecular dynamics）对该实验性连接体d(TCGGTACCGA)(4)的系综进行表征，比较了AMBER力场parmbsc1、OL21和OL24在OPC水及匹配离子条件下的表现。在每个力场中，连接体探索了一个宽广且近乎平坦的臂间角景观，在2-90度的臂间角范围内变化小于1 kcal/mol：开放状态被优先选择，能量优势为0.45-0.63 kcal/mol，晶体学样臂间角出现在2-5%的帧中，且交叉结构无论开放还是紧凑均保持同轴堆叠。一个Mg(2+)离子在92-94%的帧中占据交叉口袋，特异性地桥接A链和C链磷酸基团（Li-Merz CM Mg(2+)参数集）。在该最小短臂构建体中，A/C连续型与晶体学B/D型之间的堆叠异构体交换以约0.5 ns(-1)的速率进行，与力场无关，且A/C连续型以约2:1的比例被优先选择。parmbsc1产生的连接体比OL21和OL24更开放，后者重现了39-43度的晶体学臂间角；OL24中靶向的糖环折叠转变在连接体处也可见。这些结果为含交叉纳米结构的模拟引导设计建立了力场稳健的基线。
